Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game and India Women makes it two wins out of two while West Indies Women will have to win their next game to keep their hopes alive in the tournament. However, the action in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup, 2023 continues as Ireland Women are set to take on Pakistan Women in a bit. So, you can switch tabs to enjoy all the coverage of that game. Cheers!

Harmanpreet Kaur, the winning skipper of India Women says that it was a great day for them and they did really well with their bowling. Claims that they discussed in the team meeting about Deepti Sharma’s performance in the last game as she was not happy and the bowling coach helped her therefore she got the rewards. Mentions that Richa Ghosh has been great for them and she is doing well which is good as she is s dangerous batter who loves to express herself. Ends by saying that she is happy with what is happening so far and next game is important so they want to continue the rhythm.

As Hayley Matthews went off the field injured, Shemaine Campbelle, the vice-captain of West Indies Women comes up for the interview. She says that they did not start well with the bat and something around 140 would have been a good total. Adds that going ahead one of their top three batters need to bat deep and they need to finish well too. Credits Karishma Ramharack for her bowling effort and says that she is an important part of the team. Informs that there is no update on the injury of Hayley Matthews.

Deepti Sharma is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her brilliant bowling performance. She says that she feels good about her performance. Adds that she had some specific plans for different Windies batters and it worked out in the end. (Talking about taking 100 T20I wickets)Tells that it is nice to achieve a milestone like that, but she just wants to contribute to the team and that is her main aim. Mentions that the wicket was turning and she focused on attacking the stumps which got her the rewards.
Time for the presentations...

West Indies Women will be ruing the opportunity they had early in the game as they started well despite losing skipper Hayley Matthews early. Shemaine Campbelle and Stafanie Taylor added 73 runs together but they lost a few wickets in quick succession which pegged them back quite drastically. Chedean Nation and Shabika Gajnabi looked to push the scoring but were unable to help their side cross the 120-run mark. Deepti Sharma was the pick of the bowlers for India Women taking three scalps and getting to 100 T20I wickets thereby becoming the first Indian to achieve this feat. Renuka Singh and Pooja Vastrakar were also impressive with the ball and together they made the job quite easy for their batters.

India Women started the run chase strong with Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana scoring 28 runs in the first two overs from the pacers but they found it difficult once the spinners came into play. Smriti Mandhana was dismissed playing a rash shot and Jemimah Rodrigues could not carry her form from the last game into this match. When Shafali Verma holed out in the deep it looked like West Indies Women may find a way back into this game. Harmanpreet Kaur got together with Richa Ghosh and added 72 runs for the fourth wicket to take their team close to the finish line. Harmanpreet Kaur did give her wicket away but Richa Ghosh is showing how much she has matured as a cricketer.

Richa Ghosh is India Women's designated finisher! Another comfortable win for India Women as they seal their second win of the campaign winning this game by 6 wickets with 11 balls to spare. West Indies Women did start the game off well but could not sustain their performance and have now lost 15 consecutive T20I games in a row. This is their eighth loss in a row against this opposition and their World Cup dreams now lie in the balance with their second defeat in as many games. Karishma Ramharack was a revelation though as she claimed two wickets for 14 runs in her four overs. Hayley Matthews was also good with the ball but the pace bowlers were taken for plenty. They do have massive issues with Stafanie Taylor and Hayley Matthews both leaving the field with injuries.

FOUR! Richa Ghosh makes sure there isn't! She finishes things off in style! Shamilia Connell bangs this short and on middle, Richa Ghosh stays there and pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
A wicket-maiden over! This is full and on off, Devika Vaidya drives it towards point. Is there a twist in the game?
Devika Vaidya is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! An excellent catch in the deep! Harmanpreet Kaur holes out now! Chinelle Henry serves this full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes for the big shot, but slices it in the air in front sweeper cover. Three fielders are converging for the catch, but Shemaine Campbelle keeps her calm, runs forward and pouches it safely in the end. India Women four down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Shemaine Campbelle b Chinelle Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Four dots in a row now! This is the replay of the previous delivery. Harmanpreet Kaur misses her cut once again due to the bounce.
BEATEN! Chinelle Henry bowls this on a hard length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur tries ot cut again, but this time gets beaten by the extra bounce.
This is on a good length and outside off again, Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it straight to point again.
Looks like Hayley Matthews will not continue as she walks off the field for some further treatment.
Back of a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur taps it towards backward point.

That does not look good for West Indies Women! Hayley Matthews is down now as she lands on the ball and it seems like she has done some harm to herself. They are calling for the physios but she stands up on her own and looks to shake it off. She will continue and we are set to resume.

Back of a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it towards point where Hayley Matthews dives to her left to stop it. A single is taken. However, Hayley Matthews looks in some pain as she landed on the ball while making that stop. India Women one boundary away from the win!
Short and outside off, Richa Ghosh slashes it towards deep point for a single.

Another slower delivery, back of a length and on off, Richa Ghosh tries to cut it away again, but misses and it goes towards the keeper where Rashada Williams pouches it very low to her left. There is an appeal for the catch, but turned down. West Indies Women takes the review. The umpire wants to check if the catch is clean or not and after a few replays she deems that the ball has touched the ground before Rashada Williams grabs it. So, Richa Ghosh is safe.

FOUR! Fine shot! Shabika Gajnabi bowls this slower, short of a length and on off, Richa Ghosh waits for it and slaps it over mid off for another boundary. India Women now one big hit away from victory.
This is on a good length and on off, Richa Ghosh dabs it towards backward point.
FOUR! Richa Ghosh looks in a hurry now! Shabika Gajnabi lands this short and outside off, Richa Ghosh stays there and cuts it over point for a boundary.
On a length and around off, Richa Ghosh opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for one more.
Touch fuller and around leg, slower root, Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it towards short fine leg for a run.
Back of a length and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it towards point.
Another short delivery, on off, Richa Ghosh cuts it uppishly but it falls just short of point and the fielder makes half stop. They cross.
Short again and outside off, Richa Ghosh trues to reach for it, but misses.
FOUR! Powered away! Chinelle Henry lands thsi short and on off, Richa Ghosh gets into position quickly and hammers it away towards the deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A bit short and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur turns it towards short mid-wicket. India Women need 21 runs in 30 balls now!
Looped up, full and on off, Richa Ghosh comes down the track and drives it towards long off for a run.

DROPPED! Richa Ghosh gets a life here! This is tossed up around off, Richa Ghosh looks to push it away, but gets a thin outside edge behind where Rashada Williams fails to grab it and it goes off towards the thrid man region. Two runs taken. However, the umpires wants to check if there is a short run or not. The replays shows that it is not and it will be two runs.
Flighted, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur uses her feet and slogs it down to long on for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, turning in, Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it down the pitch.
Tossed up, full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it wide of sweeper covers for a brace.
Hayley Matthews brings herself back into the attack.

Short this time and outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts this to the right of point and looks for a quick single. Could have been in trouble here had the bowler collected the throw better. 27 runs needed in 36 balls.
FOUR! Easy to put away for Harmanpreet Kaur! A low full toss on the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for four runs.
Really short and wide outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets well across and cuts this late but finds the backward point fielder.
Loopy delivery bowled slightly short and in line with the stumps. Harmanpreet Kaur goes deep in the crease and blocks the ball back down the pitch.
Full once again and into the stumps. Harmanpreet Kaur hits this inside out towards deep cover for a couple of runs.
Afy Fletcher floats this one full and outside the off stump. Richa Ghosh eases this down to long on for one.
A tad bit fuller this time and into the stumps. Richa Ghosh flicks this towards deep square leg for another run.
Short this time and outside the off stump. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls this towards deep square leg for one.
Continues to bowl full and outside the off stump. Harmanpreet Kaur strokes this towards deep cover for a couple of runs.
Bowls this full and outside the off pole. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to heave this into the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
On a good length and outside the off stump. Harmanpreet Kaur dabs this towards the point.
Shakera Selman bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Richa Ghosh clips this towards deep square leg for one.
Keeps banging it in short and in line with the stumps. Harmanpreet Kaur swats this towards deep backward square leg and this time they get two runs.
Short once again and straying down leg. Richa Ghosh pulls this towards deep backward square leg for one.

FOUR! This has been dispatched to the fence! Good exhibition of power from Richa Ghosh. Shamilia Connell bowls this back of a length and outside the off pole. Richa Ghosh gets into position in a flash and pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
On a shorter length this time and outside the off stump. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls this towards deep backward square leg for one.
Bowls this one on a good length and just outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur dabs this back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Shamilia Connell bowls this full and in line with the stumps. Richa Ghosh clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shamilia Connell comes back into the attack now. She conceded 14 runs in her first over.
Bowls this short and outside the off stump. Richa Ghosh pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN! Bowls this outside the off stump and on a good length. Richa Ghosh hangs he bat out to dry and gets beaten all ends up.
A tad bit fuller this time and outside off. Richa Ghosh swings her blade hard and slices the ball over the cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Continues to bowl on a good length and outside the off pole. Richa Ghosh dabs this towards the point fielder.
Bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Richa Ghosh looks to go hard at the ball but misses.

NO BALL! Bowls this back of a length as well and in line with the stumps. Harmanpreet Kaur swivels and pulls this towards deep backward square leg for a single. Shakera Selman has overstepped though and it will be a no ball with a Free-Hit coming up.
Shakera Selman bowls this short and wide outside the off stump. Richa Ghosh slaps this towards deep point for a single.

DRINKS! India Women got off to a flier but then lost three wickets in quick succession to send some jitters down the dressing room. Harmanpreet Kaur and Richa Ghosh are building a nice partnership and taking their side closer to the finish line. West Indies Women need a few quick wickets here to put the pressure back on the Indians with 55 runs needed in 60 balls now. Shakera Selman to bowl after the break.
Short and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes on the back foot and pushes it back towards the bowler.
Quicker one, fullish and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur waits for it and steers it late towards the vacant third man region for a brace.
Slower through the air, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur leans on and blocks it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh eases it towards long on for a run.
Flatter, full and around leg, Harmanpreet Kaur works it towards square leg for a single.
Floated, short and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur dabs it towards backward point.
Flighted, full and on leg, Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Two in a row! Afy Fletcher floats this up around off, Harmanpreet Kaur this time skips down the track and smashes it over covers for another boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! This is tossed up, full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur stays there and drives it past covers for a boundary.
Slightly shorter and on off, Richa Ghosh makes room and late cuts it wide of short third man, Rashada Williams chases it and dives to keep it inside. Three runs taken!
Short again and outside off, Richa Ghosh punches it towards point where the fielder only manages to parry it behind and allows the second run.
Afy Fletcher begins with a short delivery and outside off, Richa Ghosh cuts it towards deep point where the fielder makes a sliding stop. Two runs taken!

Slight halt! Stafanie Taylor is on the floor and she does not look to be in good shape here. The stretcher has been brought out and she will not be able to continue in this game as the injury resurfaces. A big blow for West Indies Women for their World Cup campaign. We are all set to resume.
Short again and around leg, Harmanpreet Kaur helps it towards short fine leg. She wants the run, but is sent back by Shafali Verma.
Shortish and on middle, Richa Ghosh pulls it towards deep square leg for another run.
Looped up, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh turns it towards short mid-wicket.
Flighted, full and on middle, Richa Ghosh drives it towards mid off.
Floated, full and on off, Richa Ghosh pushes it towards covers.
Who will walk out?

OUT! TAKEN! Karishma Ramharack strikes! This is a huge blow for India Women, but West Indies Women are delighted. This is tossed up, full and on off, Shafali Verma goes down and slog-sweeps it, but finds the fielder at deep square leg where Afy Fletcher makes no mistake. Shafali Verma is disappointed with herself, but she has to back to the hut now.
Commentary.Howout: c Afy Fletcher b Karishma Ramharack

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, short and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur works it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker one, short and around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur goes for the cut, but misses due to the extra bounce off the surface.
Shortish and on middle, Shafali Verma tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air, short and on off, Shafali Verma keeps it out towards short mid-wicket.
A low full toss, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur drills it towards long on for a run.
A bit short and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur goeson the back foot and blocks it back towards the bowler.
Shortish and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur works it to wide of square leg for one.
Quicker one, short and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it towards point.
Looped up, on a yorker length and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur digs it out towards covers.
Flatter and short again, on off, Shafali Verma flicks it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Shafali Verma moves back and cuts it but straight to point.
FOUR! Fine shot! This is tossed up, full and around off, Shafali Verma moves across and slogs it wide of long on for a boundary.
Flights this one full and outside the off stump. Harmanpreet Kaur gets her front foot forward and blocks this solidly to the left of the bowler.
Harmanpreet Kaur comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Hayley Matthews builds the pressure nicely through the over and gets rewarded for it! Jemimah Rodrigues feels like she needs to get a move on and that plays right into the hands of the opposition skipper. Hayley Matthews floats this one full and outside the off stump. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to smash this back past the bowler but does not get elevation or the power. Ends up hitting it straight at the bowler who makes no mistake in pouching the catch. India Women lose their second wicket in quick time and are in a spot of bother here.
Tosses this one full and just outside the off stump, Jemimah Rodrigues defends this back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Short and outside the off stump. Jemimah Rodrigues rocks back and looks to cut this away but gets beaten.
Flighted full and outside the off stump. Shafali Verma slog sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is short and spinning into the stumps. Shafali Verma looks to get across the stumps and tuck it leg side but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Flighted full and just outside the off pole. Shafali Verma moves around in the crease and flicks this towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and in line with the stumps. Jemimah Rodrigues tucks this towards deep backward square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues defends this solidly into the off side.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! STUMPED! Karishma Ramharack gets the breakthrough and sends the dangerous Smriti Mandhana back to the pavilion! This is floated full and wide outside the off stump. Smriti Mandhana charges down the wicket and looks to loft this into the off side but is unable to connect. The ball zips past the bat and Rashada Williams does no mistake in collecting the ball and whipping the bails off. West Indies Women draw first blood and they could find a way back in this game with their slower bowlers.
Commentary.Howout: st Rashada Williams b Karishma Ramharack

Commentary.Commentary: Floated full and outside the off stump. Smriti Mandhana pushes this towards cover.
Karishma Ramharack bowls this short and outside the off stump. Shafali Verma pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
Short and served outside off. Shafali Verma pulls this towards wide long on for a single to keep strike.
A full toss this time outside the off pole. Shafali Verma knocks this towards the non-striker and the ball hits Smriti Mandhana's bat and goes past the bowler.
Bowls this one short and outside off. Shafali Verma dabs this back towards the bowler.
Tosses this one full and outside the off stump. Smriti Mandhana strokes this to the right of mid off for one.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Shafali Verma clips this towards mid-wicket for a run.
Hayley Matthews begins with full delivery served outside off. Shafali Verma hits this hard towards mid off.
Hayley Matthews brings herself into the attack now.

FOUR! That is more like it from Smriti Mandhana and she would have loved how that sounded off the bat! On a fuller length and outside the off pole. Smriti Mandhana gets her front foot forward and thumps this towards deep cover for yet another boundary.

FOUR! Smriti Mandhana gets her first boundary and not where she had intended it to go! Chinelle Henry bowls this on a good length and just outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to flick this leg side but gets a leading edge towards third man for four runs.
Goes full this time and outside leg. Smriti Mandhana misses her flick and gets hit on the pads.
This is short and wide outside off. Shafali Verma cuts this hard towards deep backward point for a single.

FOUR! Boundaries coming thick and fast for Shafali Verma but an element of luck in this one! Chinelle Henry bowls this slightly fuller and angles this into the batter. Shafali Verma goes hard at the ball and gets an inside edge towards fine leg for four runs.
Chinelle Henry bangs this in short and outside the off stump. Smriti Mandhana gets on top of the bounce and pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
Chinelle Henry to bowl from the othe end.

That is more like it from Shamilia Connell as she ends the over with two outstanding deliveries! This is on a good length as well and the ball nips back in from outside off. Shafali Verma pushes at this and gets beaten on the inside edge.
Beaten! On a good length and outside the off stump. Shafali Verma feels for this one and does not get bat on it.
WIDE! Poor delivery bowled well beyond the tram line on the off side. Shafali Verma leaves this one alone and the umpire calls wide.

FOUR! The third boundary in the over and this is not a great start for West Indies Women! This is bowled on a shorter length and wide outside off. Shafali Verma upper cuts this over the slip cordon towards third man for four runs.
Bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps Shafali Verma looks to clip this leg side but gets a leading edge towards mid off.

FOUR! An action replay of the previous ball! Shamilia Connell continues to bowl short and offers width outside off. Shafali Verma continues to feast on this and cuts this towards deep point for four more run.
FOUR! Shafali Verma is off and running in typical fashion! Shamilia Connell bowls this short and outside the off stump. Shafali Verma slaps this into the gap towards deep point for four runs.
WIDE Shamilia Connell begins with a wayward delivery bowled on a good length but well down leg side. Shafali Verma misses her flick and the umpire calls this wide.
